purpose: Map G18 fast risk overlay gates to the existing factor library for future integration. NOT auto-reweighting — requires separate IC validation cycle before any weight changes.

mapping.rationale: High volume + rejection shadow = classic exhaustion pattern. Needs separate factor to capture reversal probability at extremes.

mapping.rationale: F30 already captures volume confirmation. R1 gate provides real-time override when F30 signal is extreme (>= 2x). No new factor needed.

mapping.combined_signal: 短周期反转 / 结构破位
mapping.rationale: F11 captures reversal momentum but not structural level breaks. A dedicated fast-reversal factor would distinguish between momentum fade and hard level failure.

mapping.combined_signal: 低波防御 / 风格轮动风险
mapping.rationale: Style headwind is a regime phenomenon. F10/F31 capture vol/tail aspects but not the interaction between stock style and market regime preference.

prohibitions.description: Do not modify any factor's long-term weight based on the 4-scenario replay test. Replay proves the overlay works, NOT that factor weights should change.
prohibitions.rationale: 4 scenarios is micro-sample. Weight changes require full IC validation across 500+ samples minimum.

prohibitions.description: Do not use micro-sample monitoring results (N<30) to claim alpha discovery or factor importance.
prohibitions.rationale: Statistical significance requires sample size. Monitoring is for anomaly detection, not alpha claims.

prohibitions.description: Do not attribute the G18 overlay fix as evidence that factor IC is validated. The overlay is a risk-management mechanism, not an alpha signal.
prohibitions.rationale: Risk overlay veto (fast variables) operates on a different plane than factor alpha (slow variables). Mixing them is a category error.

prohibitions.description: Do not retrospectively optimize factor weights to 'predict' the scenarios that G18 failed on. This is overfitting to known failures.
prohibitions.rationale: The goal is structural robustness, not curve-fitting to 4 known cases.
